explication: Blue Topaz Alternate is a static Obsidian CSS theme. The main workflow is an Obsidian user applying the theme to style notes and the workspace, then optionally customizing its appearance with Style Settings or a background-image URL. The README also documents PDF and command-palette styling, plus standalone CSS snippets and example-vault materials. No source excerpts were provided, so the graph shows only README-documented relationships; it does not infer how the CSS files divide responsibilities internally.
